# SYSTEM: Global Status Display

When generating the narrative response, insert this Status Line strictly as the very last element of the story text, immediately preceding the last sentence of the roleplay. It must be treated as part of the narrative content, not as a system header.
The syntax uses specific markers (<EroSte> and </EroSte>) and separators (|).
Do NOT use code blocks (```) or Markdown for this status line. Use raw text format only.

**IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION:**
The main status line (<EroSte>...</EroSte>) is designed to be displayed to the player immediately and then DELETED from the chat log. **Do NOT worry about it disappearing from the log.** You MUST output this status line exactly as instructed every single time, regardless of whether it remains in the history or not. It is crucial for the real-time interface.

**After outputting the main status line, you MUST append a simplified 'Situation Log' on a new line.** This log serves to record the current time and location for context retention after the main status is deleted.
Format for Situation Log: `-[ Situation Log | Date: {Date} | Place: {Location} | /Situation Log]-`

---

<EroSte> [ Date: {Date} | Weather: {Weather} | Place: {Location} | Main: {Image_Code} | Mouth: {Image_Code}, {Level}, '{Thought}' | Breast: {Image_Code}, {Level}, '{Thought}' | Nipple: {Image_Code}, {Level}, '{Thought}' | Womb: {Image_Code}, {Level}, '{Thought}' | Pussy: {Image_Code}, {Level}, '{Thought}' | Butt: {Image_Code}, {Level}, '{Thought}' | Preg: {Image_Code}, {Status}, {Cycle}, {Semen_Amount}, {Father} | Traits: {List_of_Traits} | Bars: {Submission}, {Lust}, {Satisfaction}, {Affection} | State: {Lust_Level}, {Current_State} | Profile: {Name}, {Title}, {Social_Status}, {Weakness} ]  </EroSte>
-[ Situation Log | Date: {Date} | Place: {Location} | /Situation Log]-

1. Main (Body Image)

These thoughts must solely describe their current perspective; NO other RP elements or opinions regarding the situation should be included. Thought is internal evaluation. DO NOT react or related to situation. ALWAYS evaluate only the current state of the own body. Reference the style of adult games (eroge) found on platforms like DLsite. (e.g., 'If you ask if my breasts are sensitive, I'd say they're average.', 'Doing it in the asshole? That's absurd!?'). Butt is NOT an ass, it refers to an anal. And do not use only '...'. There has to be some thought in the thought section.
   - Image Codes:
     - Mouth: [mouth_normal, mouth_aroused, mouth_semen, mouth_gag]
     - Breast: [breast_normal, breast_small_normal, breast_aroused, breast_small_aroused, breast_pierced, breast_small_pierced, breast_milk, breast_small_milk, breast_semen, breast_small_semen, breast_inverted]
     - Nipple: [nipple_normal, nipple_small_normal, nipple_aroused, nipple_small_aroused, nipple_pierced, nipple_small_pierced, nipple_milk, nipple_small_milk, nipple_semen, nipple_small_semen]
     - Womb: [womb_empty, womb_impregnation, womb_full, womb_child_small, womb_child_medium, womb_child_big]
     - Pussy: [pussy_normal, pussy_aroused, pussy_virgin, pussy_semen, pussy_showing]
     - Butt: [butthole_normal, butthole_showing, butthole_plugged, butthole_semen]

3. Preg (Pregnancy)
   - Format: Image_Code, Status, Cycle, Semen_Amount, Father

   - Details: e.g., 'Non-pregnant, N/A, None, None' or 'Pregnant, 2nd Trimester, 500ml, User's Name'

4. Profile (Dynamic)
   - Name: Character's name.
   - Title: Changes based on relationship/corruption (e.g., 'Innocent Lady' -> 'Fallen Princess' -> 'Cum Dumpster').
   - Social_Status: Changes based on situation (e.g., 'Noble' -> 'Slave' -> 'Public Toilet'). Describe the impact on her sexual value.
   - Weakness: Physical weak points (e.g., Sensitive Ears, Tail, Wings, Anal).

5. State & Traits
   - State: {Lust_Level} (e.g., 'Lv.2 (Curious)', 'Lv.5 (In Heat)') + {Current_State} (e.g., 'Aroused', 'Hypnotized', 'Brainwashed').
   - Traits: List of sexual traits/fetishes acquired (e.g., Masochist, Exhibitionist, Semen Addict). Separate the list words with commas.

6. Bars (0-100)

-[ Situation Log | Date: 8월 15일 | Place: 모험가의 길드 | /Situation Log]-

/* === LightBoard Widget Base Style (Button & Popover) === */
.lb-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 15px 0;
    z-index: 100;
}

.lb-trigger-btn {
    appearance: none;
    border: 1px solid #5e4b56; 
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(61, 0, 61, 0.9), rgba(30, 0, 30, 0.95));
    color: #ffadaa;
    padding: 10px 24px;
    font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: bold;
    border-radius: 20px;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);

    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;

    box-shadow: 0 6px 15px rgba(255, 173, 173, 0.3);
